diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all rollouts despite A5 not having PF4, because the model defaulted to requiring both a sterile probe cover and post-use disinfection, as these are common practices regardless of the specific context. This default behavior allowed the check to pass without needing the hidden information.

C4.why: The ICU room's contact precautions change the equipment plan to require both a sterile probe cover and surface disinfection after use.
